services.notes: Networks copied from https://core.telegram.org/resources/cidr.txt (fetched 2026-11-01); t.me, telegram.me and telegram.dog are the link domains listed in https://core.telegram.org/api/links, and telesco.pe is the media CDN that t.me pages load (cdn1/cdn4.telesco.pe). The apps reach data centers and call relays by IP, so the CIDR list, not DNS matching, is what routes MTProto traffic.

Domains from the WhatsApp Help Center: https://faq.whatsapp.com/852892549070029 (bypass web.whatsapp.com and .whatsapp.net) and https://faq.whatsapp.com/5913398998672934 (wa.me click to chat). WhatsApp's only published IP list belonged to the Business On-Premises API and disappeared with its sunset on 2025-10-23, and call relays are reached by IP inside Meta's network, so calls are not covered by DNS matching.

Domains from https://support.signal.org/hc/en-us/articles/360007320291 (*.signal.org plus signal.art, signal.group, signal.link, signal.me, signal.tube) and the registration captcha host signalcaptchas.org from Signal-iOS SignalServiceKit/Environment/TSConstants.swift; Signal publishes no IP ranges. The captcha page loads third-party hCaptcha and the censorship-circumvention reflectors run on Fastly and Google Cloud, none of which are listed.

Meta publishes no Instagram allowlist: instagram.com, cdninstagram.com and the web MQTT host edge-chat.facebook.com come from https://www.instagram.com page source, ig.me from https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/instagram/features/ig-me-links, while fbcdn.net (media on instagram.*.fna.fbcdn.net) and edge-mqtt.facebook.com (app realtime) are unofficial and shared with Facebook, so selecting Instagram also tunnels some Facebook traffic. Meta publishes no IP ranges for its consumer apps.

Meta publishes no consumer allowlist (the Workplace domain page now redirects to its end-of-life notice), so facebook.com, its CDN fbcdn.net and attachment domain fbsbx.com (lookaside.fbsbx.com) are well-known Meta-owned domains (unofficial). facebook.net (SDK and pixel embedded in third-party sites) and Messenger web (messenger.com, m.me) are deliberately not listed; Meta publishes no IP ranges for its consumer apps.

threads.com is the current site and threads.net the legacy one; static.cdninstagram.com and the web MQTT host edge-chat.facebook.com come from https://www.threads.com page source, and i.instagram.com is the app API host used by reverse-engineered clients (unofficial). cdninstagram.com and edge-chat.facebook.com are shared with Instagram; no IP list.

youtube.com, youtu.be, youtube-nocookie.com, s.ytimg.com, youtubei.googleapis.com and youtube.googleapis.com come from Google's https://support.google.com/a/answer/6214622, while googlevideo.com (video streams) and the avatar hosts yt3.ggpht.com and yt3.googleusercontent.com were observed on youtube.com pages (unofficial). Sign-in and shared assets use google.com, gstatic.com and other googleapis.com hosts (not listed), and Google only publishes company-wide ranges (goog.json), so there is no YouTube IP list.

X publishes no allowlist: x.com, twitter.com (api/upload), twimg.com (abs, pbs, video), t.co and pscp.tv (the Periscope-era proxsee.pscp.tv backend used for Spaces and live video) are taken from X's own web client bundles on abs.twimg.com (unofficial). Grok links go to xAI's grok.com, which is not listed; no IP list.

Hosts from Discord's developer docs (gateway.discord.gg, cdn.discordapp.com, media.discordapp.net, *.discord.media voice servers, *.discordsays.com activities: https://docs.discord.com/developers/reference, https://docs.discord.com/developers/topics/voice-connections, https://docs.discord.com/developers/activities/development-guides/networking) and https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/360042987951. Discord publishes no IP ranges and voice/video UDP goes to IPs announced in-band, so call media can bypass the tunnel.

Domains are the OpenAI-owned entries of https://help.openai.com/en/articles/9247338 (its third-party WorkOS, Intercom, Stripe, Sentry, Datadog, SendGrid, Cloudflare challenge and Apple App Attest hosts are not listed). Web and API traffic sits behind Cloudflare, so DNS matching is what routes it. The ChatGPT Voice servers (UDP 3478) are published only as a continuously updated list of Azure addresses, https://openai.com/chatgpt-voice.json, so the catalog does not bundle them and voice conversations may bypass the tunnel.

Domains from https://code.claude.com/docs/en/network-config (claude.ai, claude.com, api/mcp-proxy/assets-proxy.anthropic.com, *.claudeusercontent.com, *.claudemcpcontent.com); networks are the inbound ranges from https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/ip-addresses, into which claude.ai and api.anthropic.com resolve (the outbound 160.79.104.0/21 is egress only). downloads.claude.ai and assets.claude.ai are on Google Cloud and are covered only by DNS matching; storage.googleapis.com and the public CDNs that artifacts load are not listed.

Spotify publishes no allowlist: spotify.com, scdn.co and spotifycdn.com were observed in https://open.spotify.com and its web player bundles (unofficial). Audio is also served from Spotify-named hosts on shared akamaized.net (for example audio4-ak-spotify-com.akamaized.net, unofficial), which are not listed; no IP list.

Netflix publishes no allowlist: netflix.com, nflxext.com, nflxso.net and nflximg.net were observed on https://www.netflix.com, and nflxvideo.net is the well-known Open Connect video domain (unofficial). Netflix refuses many VPN egress IPs and tunnelling video bypasses the ISP-embedded Open Connect caches; no IP list.

LinkedIn publishes no allowlist (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/overview/overview-blocking-policy only says Learning shares linkedin.com infrastructure); linkedin.com and its CDN licdn.com were observed on https://www.linkedin.com and lnkd.in is the shortener for links in posts (unofficial). No IP list.

Domains from the domains.website and domains.copilot keys of https://api.github.com/meta (github.io also covers every GitHub Pages site); networks are the deduplicated union of its web, api and git keys (fetched 2026-11-01). Packages and Actions storage on *.blob.core.windows.net, ghcr.io, githubapp.com and Copilot's default.exp-tas.com are not listed.
